correctness.rationale: Chen--Lee prove the specific Q-Gorenstein smoothing from P(2,18,25,45) to Y_10. Kawasaki cohomology gives rational Betti numbers (1,0,1,0,1,0,1) for the central weighted projective threefold, while the standard Y_10 Hodge table with h^{1,2}=2 gives (1,0,1,4,1,0,1) for the smooth fiber. A Cartier multiple of the relative anticanonical bundle supplies specialization-compatible nonzero generators in degrees 2, 4, and 6, so those one-dimensional specialization maps are isomorphisms. The nearby/vanishing-cycle long exact sequence therefore forces all rational vanishing hypercohomology to vanish except H^3, where it is Q^4.

value.rationale: The initiating paper explicitly uses vanishing cycles to resolve the Picard-rank question for this new smoothing. The present claim completes that topological picture at the level of rational cohomology: every rational topological change is concentrated in the middle degree and has exact rank four. This supplies a compact invariant and a concrete checksum for any finer future computation of the local-system monodromy, integral vanishing lattice, or Hodge-theoretic vanishing cycles.
